title: Drift Signal - First Attempt at game dev
author: fictiva
selftext:
Hi everyone! Drift Signal is my first game, developed with ChatGPT’s help and published in [https://fictiva.itch.io/drift-signal](https://fictiva.itch.io/drift-signal).

It’s a solo sci-fi dice game where you roll, explore, scavenge, and try to survive a six-day expedition.

The development process has been conversational and iterative, I described a feature or change, worked through the implementation with AI, and requested further revisions. I also used AI-generated imagery for the cover and promotional artwork.

I'm open to comments and suggestions
